## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish special episode of Store Penge about the US midterm elections, which the Democrats won decisively: they took the Senate and governor races in Texas and Georgia and the majority in both chambers of Congress. Hosts and guests put the result down to anger over affordability and inflation (linked to the Iran war), weak Republican candidates and growing scepticism about AI and data centres. On markets, the guest analyst expects some relief after the election and notes the historical pattern of better returns after midterms. He flags two risks: government shutdowns and debt-ceiling fights, and the politics turning against AI for investors heavily exposed to AI stocks.
